```{r tidy-who-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)

start_year <- 2000
end_year <- 2015

cases <- read_csv("Estimated number of malaria cases 2000-2015.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
itn <- read_csv("Prevention Insecticide-Treated Bed Net (2000-2024).csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

names(cases)
names(itn)
```


```{r filter-who-data}
# Keep WHO European Region countries and years 2000–2015

european_countries <- c(
  "Albania", "Andorra", "Armenia", "Austria", "Azerbaijan",
  "Belarus", "Belgium", "Bosnia and Herzegovina", "Bulgaria",
  "Croatia", "Cyprus", "Czechia", "Denmark", "Estonia",
  "Finland", "France", "Georgia", "Germany", "Greece",
  "Hungary", "Iceland", "Ireland", "Israel", "Italy",
  "Kazakhstan", "Kyrgyzstan", "Latvia", "Lithuania",
  "Luxembourg", "Malta", "Monaco", "Montenegro",
  "Netherlands", "North Macedonia", "Norway", "Poland",
  "Portugal", "Republic of Moldova", "Romania", "Russian Federation",
  "San Marino", "Serbia", "Slovakia", "Slovenia", "Spain",
  "Sweden", "Switzerland", "Tajikistan", "Türkiye", "Turkmenistan",
  "Ukraine", "United Kingdom", "Uzbekistan"
)

cases_clean <- cases |>
  rename(
    country = Location,
    year = Period,
    value = Value
  ) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
  filter(
    year >= start_year,
    year <= end_year,
    country %in% european_countries
  )


write_csv(cases_clean, "Estimated number of WHO Europe malaria cases 2000-2015.csv")


head(cases_clean)
```
